adjudication_trailer.SUMMARY: "120 strings: 113 pass, 7 warn, 0 fail. Every {placeholder} and HTML tag came back intact, and the arrows were flipped for right-to-left as instructed. The 7 warnings are all minor: 4 [term] (bean->task twice, renderings->views, resolved->inferred, Recent Submissions->Latest deposits) and 2 [sense] (established->proven, render->display). Correction: that is 5 [term] and 2 [sense]. Not counted as drift, because a back-translation of a correct Arabic rendering would naturally produce it: WHO spelled out as 'World Health Organization'; emblem->logo (one Arabic word covers both); upstream->'original source'; replica->'replicated copy'; visualiser->viewer; rendered->created/generated for covers and pages; withheld->'not displayed'; omitted->removed; live->active; asset->resource; accessions->'deposit dates'; stylesheet->'styles page'; 'Contact'->'Contact us'; 'Home'->'Home page'; State->Status; Where->Site; Source of record->Reference source; &->'and' (the context allows it); plural rephrasings ('Number of nodes: {n}'), which the context invited; the definite article dropped in the glossary terms; 'descriptive metadata' (the standard Arabic term for metadata). The glossary keeps 'certainty of the evidence' and 'quality of the evidence' as distinct, correct terms of art."
